9700: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
9701: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
9702: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.
9703: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
9704: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
9705: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.
